The lifetime broadening (natural line-width) of a level is set by the time–energy uncertainty relation  

ΔE · τ ≳ ħ/2   ⇒   ΔE ≈ ħ / τ .  

For the two levels

τ₁ = 10⁻⁹ s  →  ΔE₁ ≈ ħ/τ₁ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁷ eV  
τ₂ = 10⁻⁸ s  →  ΔE₂ ≈ ħ/τ₂ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁸ eV  

The combined width that must be exceeded to tell the lines apart is of order  

ΔE_width ≈ ΔE₁ + ΔE₂ ≈ 7×10⁻⁷ eV .  

Among the proposed separations, only 10⁻⁴ eV is larger than this width; the other choices (10⁻⁸ eV, 10⁻¹¹ eV, 10⁻⁹ eV) are all smaller than, or comparable to, the natural line-width and would not allow the two levels to be resolved.

Answer: B
